stage: Public-data development after prior assumption diagnostics; new splits are not new independent data or blind confirmation
source_identity: SubjectID local to experiment and natural same-task-set cohort
reports: Mean of all repeats for a worker/object; tasks-by-workers input
task_keys: Angle and Base factor used ONLY to establish opaque object identity, never numerical inference features
split: RNG(seed+100*experiment+cohort).permutation(15); first K references; all other entire objects held out for every worker
truth_visibility: cal_truth supplied to methods; test_truth used only after prediction for metrics; complete unlabeled report graph is permitted to all methods
exclusion: Constant-truth dimensions are not performance targets; previously retained as negative controls. No label-dependent object filtering.
